attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 8
attributes.name: Cloak of Winds
attributes.powers: Display this card at the start of any character's turn. While displayed, you may reduce Combat or Fire damage dealt to you by 4, and when you would be moved, you may choose not to move. At the end of your turn, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may attempt an Arcane or Divine 10 check to recharge it instead.
